scope: One-time source imports and local adaptations; historical donor paths are evidence, never build inputs. Per-entry donor_revision overrides the initial historical donor commit where present.

donor.dirty_context: Untracked planning document and two mock configuration files existed; no sampled tracked donor changes were observed.

first_party_license.evidence: No repository-level license or license headers in the sampled first-party donors were found. No new license grant is made.

status_definitions.planned: Donor identified and hashed; local implementation has not been verified against this entry.
status_definitions.materialized: Destination bytes exist and are bound by local_sha256 and local_size_bytes.
status_definitions.unresolved: Identity or acquisition evidence is unavailable; entry cannot supply build source.

local_tools.purpose: Generator-local streaming post-capture WAV integrity, level, dropout, and bounded two-anchor timing diagnostics.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library only
local_tools.notes: First-party engineering analysis tool; it does not establish M110 formal conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Waveform-agnostic PCM impairment engine (CW, static crashes, fades, sample slips, band-limited AWGN) with scenario/sidecar conventions.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library plus NumPy
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 1 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Renders perfect M110 reference WAVs with the explicit external transmitter and a PN-11 payload; writes reference sidecars.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library plus NumPy
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 1 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Runs the explicit external m110_app_decode on corpus WAVs and records mode/EOM/BER/loss-of-lock/alignment results.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 1 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Phase 1 corpus orchestrator: references, validation, impaired renders, scoring, manifests, exact-regeneration verify.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library plus NumPy
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 1 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Command-line entry for one signal_lab scenario render.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library plus NumPy
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 1 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Portable C++23 waveform-agnostic impairment engine (deterministic math, PCG32, fixed-capacity JSON scenario reader, five stages, PCM16 engine with stream digests) shared by the host renderer and the RT1170 player.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library only (no libm transcendentals)
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 2/3 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Host WAV-rendering backend for the signal-lab engine; writes the impaired WAV, a JSON sidecar and the target scenario with reference_rms injected.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 2/3 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Controlled waveform_capture session (READY, stop file, STOP, FINAL) for analog end-to-end checks.
local_tools.dependencies: PowerShell 7
local_tools.notes: First-party Phase 2/3 engineering tool; results are engineering evidence only, never formal M110 conformance.

local_tools.purpose: Encoder-agnostic sequential payload/PCM source contract, incremental canonical WAV writer and payload/WAV/PCM SHA-256 implementation.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library; local signal-lab and common status
local_tools.notes: A fake encoder test links only this library. Encoder profiles are opaque to the WAV writer.

local_tools.purpose: Bounded M110B payload-to-PCM encoder adapter over the locally imported donor TX closure.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library including the unchanged donor floating-point math; local waveform-source
local_tools.notes: The adapter preserves donor message framing, continuous FEC state and PCM quantization. Host donor equivalence is tested; cross-platform PCM identity requires measured comparison.

local_tools.purpose: Positional wfg_m110_tx utility producing clean WAV or raw PCM plus an exact retained BIN payload and JSON artifact manifest.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library; local native-m110 and waveform-source
local_tools.notes: Uses the same incremental artifact writer as firmware. Retains payload/WAV/PCM SHA-256, generator version and source manifest identity.

local_tools.purpose: Fixed-capacity WFG-LIVE/1 command parser for staged artifacts, generation requests and sample-indexed live impairment control.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library and local contracts
local_tools.notes: Transport parsing owns no waveform encoder and performs no filesystem work.

local_tools.purpose: Local artifact-control adapter for DD-006 command spellings and DD008 payload transfer.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library and local contracts
local_tools.notes: SENDBUFFER produces a WAV artifact; playback remains an explicit subsequent operation.

local_tools.purpose: Firmware composition registry mapping encoder IDs to caller-owned workspace factories and generator versions.
local_tools.dependencies: Local waveform-source and selected native-m110 adapter
local_tools.notes: Adding an encoder changes this registry and its adapter, without changing the generic WAV writer, impairment engine or player.

local_tools.purpose: Player-task-owned incremental SD payload-to-WAV artifact utility with a JSON completion marker and retained input payload.
local_tools.dependencies: Local waveform-source and encoder registry; locked FatFs and FreeRTOS
local_tools.notes: Writes temporary files, syncs and closes them, then publishes WAV and manifest. It does not feed encoder output directly to the audio codec.

local_tools.purpose: DD008 control/data bridge and bounded mailbox for USB payload uploads and SD artifact generation.
local_tools.dependencies: Local common/dd008, tx_protocol and TinyUSB transport
local_tools.notes: All filesystem and generation work stays in the player task.

local_tools.purpose: Identity-checked WFG-LIVE/1 host controller and journaled sample-indexed impairment sweeps.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library and pyserial for hardware transport
local_tools.notes: Explicit port and expected serial are required for hardware; protocol tests use a fake transport.

local_tools.purpose: Identity-checked DD008 payload upload or existing-SD-payload artifact generation utility with retained session journal.
local_tools.dependencies: Python standard library, local host/dd008.py and pyserial for hardware transport
local_tools.notes: Waits for complete artifact state and validates counters/digest syntax; playback and retrieval remain separate operations.

local_tools.purpose: Host replay of recorded sample-indexed live impairment events for deterministic PCM comparison.
local_tools.dependencies: C++23 standard library and local signal-lab
local_tools.notes: Replay evidence is distinct from unmeasured physical playback or USB timing.
